metadata.methodology: Sky Base Rate = SSR + margin. SSR read on-chain from sUSDS 0xa3931d71877C0E7a3148CB7Eb4463524FEc27fbD ssr() at the block nearest each UTC-midnight, ray → per-second-compounded APY. Margin is a Sky governance parameter (not on-chain here).

assumptions.note: Every ssr_pct is an authoritative on-chain read. Only margin_bps and the margin-change date are assumed; base_rate_pct inherits that assumption. At 2026-07-31 this reconciles to 3.72%, matching Spark's public figure.
